method: Public UI inspection; unauthenticated; no order or account was submitted.

observations.action: Read the loaded public product list
observations.finding: The visible list includes Seilbahnen und Skilifte - ganzer Kanton, Kantonales Strassennetz and Langsamverkehr des Kantons und SchweizMobil - ganzer Kanton; no operational bus-line product was visible.

The description inventories commercial chairlifts, gondolas, aerial and funicular systems, small cableways and ski lifts; it includes removable small lifts and works cableways. It says the federal concessioned cableway dataset is added on download, with stations, routes, supports and structures. No dated alignment or dataset-specific reuse terms were shown in this description.

observations.action: Search the product list for Verkehr
observations.finding: Only Langsamverkehr des Kantons und SchweizMobil - ganzer Kanton is displayed.

disposition: Official mountain-transport geometry product identified for future investigation. No local geometry admitted in this review. A public product list is not evidence that other data does not exist, and description alone does not verify operational line identities or reuse rights.
